name: manual_6f73a4
claim: When a commit hook rejects the first of several commits, everything stays staged and the next commit lands all of it as one. After a multi-batch commit sequence, check that the log shows one commit per batch; split an unpushed commit with reset --soft and recommit before pushing.

decisions.notes: Five files meant for two logical commits landed as one after a hook rejection; it was split locally before the push.

rationale: Five files meant for two logical commits landed as one after a hook rejection; it was split locally before the push.
